Subject: FW: [UAI] ICDM Data Mining Contest (ICDM DMC 2007)

Letos je za nas zanimiva (s TripTracker-jem povezana) tema 
data mining contest-a:

> This year's inaugural contest proposes a location-estimation 
> problem in an indoor wireless network environment.  The 
> problem is to accurately predict a mobile user's locations 
> from the received radio signal strength values in a wireless 
> environment.

Kaj takega bi bila tud dobra tema za diplomsko nalogo, 
ce je slucajno kdo pred diplomo (Cile, Sole, ?).

> 
> Apologies for cross-postings
> 
> ICDM Data Mining Contest (ICDM DMC) is set up to meet the 
> challenges of novel, difficult and high-impact real world 
> data mining problems.
> 
> We strive to make this contest series an important part of 
> the IEEE ICDM Conference in the future.
> 
> This year's inaugural contest proposes a location-estimation 
> problem in an indoor wireless network environment.  The 
> problem is to accurately predict a mobile user's locations 
> from the received radio signal strength values in a wireless 
> environment.
> 
> For more information, please see 
> http://www.cse.ust.hk/~qyang/ICDMDMC07/, or contact sinnopan 
> at cse.ust.hk and qyang at cse.ust.hk
> 
> The co-chairs for the ICDM DMC07 Contest are:
> 
> 	Chris Ding, University of Texas at Arlington (USA)
> 	Gang Kou, Thomson Corporation (USA)
> 	Qiang Yang, Hong Kong UST
> 
> The important dates are:
> 
> Aug 16, 2007	Task description, training datasets and 
> registration available online
> Sept 16, 2007	Test data available
> Sept 26, 2007	Submissions of estimation results (by midnight PST)
> Oct 1, 2007	Submission of brief algorithm description (by 
> midnight PST)
> Oct 28-31, 2007	Contest Winner Presentation at ICDM Conference
>
